excerpts: At 83 years old, Horie had made another record, now as the oldest man to have completed a solo voyage across the Pacific in a sailing vessel. |Kenichi Horie, standing on the deck of the Mermaid, arriving in San Francisco in 1962. NPS Image Kenichi Horie is regarded as one of Japan’s most famous yachtsman. He is the first known man in history to make a non-stop solo crossing of the Pacific Ocean. At just 23-year-old, Horie sailed his 19-foot black plywood sloop, the Mermaid , from Osaka, Japan to San Francisco, California on a solo sailing voyage. His arrival through the Golden Gate on Sunday, August 12, 1962 was entirely unannounced. He had, in fact, left Japanese waters without any form of official clearance on May 12th, 1962.
